title: Failure modes by weight of evidence
caption: Bar. One row per failure mode, sorted as entered. Reads off the Verification Asymmetry tab, so a new mode there appears here.
rows: Confident wrong answer, delivered as fact
Unrequested summary drops the part that was needed
Answer describes the previous frame, not the current one
Numerals wrong, or read with no meaning attached
Off-frame content missed, or a bare no with nothing after it
Cannot tell whether it is recording
Framing and aiming fail with no coaching to fix it
State of things not judged: doneness, cleanliness, appliance setting
Low light, glare and lamination degrade the read
Read or task stops mid-way and restarts from the beginning
Refusal on policy grounds: cards, medical text, people, copyright
Refusal on a device state that is not true
No control over detail level, background clutter reported
Command not registered, wake or syntax failure
Accent and non-native speech not recognised
Absence reported where the thing is present
Answer positioned for a sighted user, direction with no distance
No verification route exists for this user
Read drops when the head moves or looks down
Command runs as the wrong action
Changing state not tracked: which light blinks, which item has focus
Unfamiliar or cultural item not identified
Person described with the wrong gender or pronoun
